meta.title: Dave Football Coaching — Hernando County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Spring Hill, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Dave
about.bio: I am 5"8" with very small hands but I was able to throw a football 50 yards with pinpoint accuracy in my prime. It's all about the details when playing any sport but so much more important when playing QB. I have been successful in business because of my commitment to continuous improvement. I take the same approach to coaching football as I am also a student of the game. My photo below is an Example of using what I've learned along the way. My pool drill has many benefits. Most of what I coach is from watching great QB's and picking up on the details. I also treat and coach each QB differently based on their skillset. I will also coach based on your offense that your school or team runs. I also highly recommend bringing your favorite receiver.

hero.headline: Hernando County's Premier Football Coach
